title: Grateful Dead Live at Rosemont Horizon on 1989-04-11
source: Master Audience Recorded By Mr. Darby; AKGC451E/CK1s (PAS/Section 2, Row 42, Seat 8/6 Feet High)> AKG9V Phantom Power>Sony TC-D5M,Tapes:Set 1 Maxell MX,Set 2 TDK MA-X; Transfer Information:Tascam 112 MKII (XLR Out)>Tascam HD-P2 @ 24/48> HDD>Amadeus Pro (Tracking/Fades/FLAC8); Tracks Renamed/Metadata Tagging With Tag&Rename By Keo

ai_review.summary: A crisp, well‑EQ'd tape captures a great first set and an exhilarating Crazy Fingers suite despite some early second‑set roughness.
ai_review.review: The recording is sweet and clear with only a touch of hiss, making the show easy to enjoy. The first set shines, though three new 1989 tunes interrupt its flow, while the second set starts noisy before settling into a sublime Crazy Fingers suite that carries the performance to a high point.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review, but it is overwhelmingly positive about both the musical performance and the tape quality; limited data reduces confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: EQed for loudness, crisp tape with minimal noise/mush; no major drop‑outs mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is strong, briefly interrupted by three new tunes that are still rough but enjoyable; second set starts noisy/sloppy then tightens up into an excellent Crazy Fingers suite.
